== Original printed-face source; card data unchanged ==
Added the [https://web.archive.org/web/20080512202708/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/r3t6.html archived original Decipher card page] as an explicitly labeled original printed-face source. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20030622013906im_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/r3t6.gif original black-border scan] and current wiki image were visually checked. The original face has no printed Nav Computer icon. The existing navigation capability is retained: the Decipher Glossary, pp. 15 and 94, explains that astromech droids provide nav computers. The rules source is distinct from the printed-face citation; no icon field was changed. Existing secondary sources are retained. No game text, lore, stats, icons, UID, version label, image, printings or sibling page was changed; the citation does not certify the current data as identical to the original face.
